title: MovieDB Watchlist (repository)
src: Amazon SDE Intern OA 2026 · section 2, AI-assisted repository task
body:
MovieDB is an app that allows users to explore movies, submit ratings, and share reviews.

The watchlist feature helps users save and manage movies they want to watch later. Currently, this feature is not functioning correctly on the backend, affecting usability and engagement.

Issue summary: users can add movies to their watchlist, but these movies do not appear on the Watchlist page. Fix the backend of the watchlist feature.

Steps to reproduce (the app's pages call these API routes):

  1. Log in with the test credentials sam.rivera@email.com / Password@123 (POST /api/auth/login).
  2. Select a movie and add it to the watchlist (POST /api/watchlist/add).
  3. Open the Watchlist page (GET /api/watchlist/). The movie should appear here, but currently there are none.
  4. Users should be able to remove movies from the watchlist, either from the Watchlist page or by toggling Add to Watchlist on the movie page (POST /api/watchlist/remove, GET /api/watchlist/check/<movieId>). This doesn't work either.

Additional requirements: to prevent spam or automated activity, the system must apply rate limiting. Each user can only add or remove movies up to 10 times within any 2-minute period.

Refer to the README.md file for more details.

Note: the acceptance criteria for this task require that your solution pass all predefined unit tests. Use failing test cases to guide debugging. More tests run when you submit.
